@@ output/template/.claude/skills/custom-settings/SKILL.md ;; Workflow skill routed from CLAUDE.md; reminded by post-edit and Stop hooks.
@scope workflow custom-settings
1-7 IM ;; Frontmatter.
9 NN ;; Banner.
11 NN ;; Heading.
13-16 OL [gov009.resolve-before]
18 NN ;; Heading.
20-26 OL [gov021.add-setting]
28-29 EX [x.single-source]
31 NN ;; Heading.
33-43 OL [gov021.propagate-search]
45-46 OL [gov021.only-affected]
48 NN ;; Heading.
50-52 OL [pst009.route-persistence-change]
54 NN ;; Heading.
56-59 OL [fe010.settings-consistency]
61 NN ;; Heading.
63-70 OL [gov021.verification]
72-73 OL [gov021.not-one-literal]

C gov009.resolve-before OL GOV-009 MUST ;; If SPECIFICATION.md and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md conflict, resolve the conflict before changing implementation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.add-setting OL GOV-021,GOV-008,GOV-010 MUST ;; After approval record the setting with a stable descriptive name, update owning code/validation/configuration, tests and externally relevant documentation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.single-source EX GOV-021,GOV-012 AVOID ;; Avoid duplicating the same literal across layers when a single source in code or configuration is appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;; Single-source preference not in GOV-021.
C gov021.propagate-search OL GOV-021 MUST ;; When an approved value changes update every affected surface, searching old value/name, validators/DTO constraints, Domain/Application checks, DB mapping, frontend validation/hints, tests/data, docs/examples, mirrored configuration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.only-affected OL GOV-021,GOV-014 MUST ;; Separate occurrences expressing the setting from numeric coincidences; update only affected behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.route-persistence-change OL PST-009 MUST ;; If a setting affects schema constraints, indexes, column lengths or other persistence metadata run persistence-change § Schema-Affecting Settings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.settings-consistency OL FE-010,GOV-021 MUST ;; When frontend and backend expose the same constraint backend validation stays authoritative and frontend validation/messages are kept synchronized. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.verification OL GOV-021,GOV-009,WF-003 MUST ;; Before completion search stale references, build affected projects, run relevant tests, verify persistence changes, check SPECIFICATION.md conflicts and run verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.not-one-literal OL GOV-021 MUST_NOT ;; Changing one literal alone does not establish synchronization; do not declare it synchronized because one constant changed. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/skills/development-workflow/SKILL.md ;; Workflow skill routed from CLAUDE.md for non-trivial implementation work.
@scope workflow development-workflow
1-7 IM ;; Frontmatter.
9 NN ;; Banner.
11 NN ;; Heading.
13 NN ;; Heading.
15-17 OL [gov002.read-sources]
19 NN ;; Heading.
21-22 OL [wf001.inspect-apply]
24-34 OL [wf001.read-owning-rules] ;; Explicit owner reads for greenfield/unopened files, with the area-to-rules table.
36 OL [wf001.knowledge-skills]
38 NN ;; Heading.
40-44 OL [gov017.classify-request,gov018.raise-concerns]
46 NN ;; Heading.
48-55 OL [wf001.route-specialized]
57-59 OL [tst009.regression]
61-67 OL [run012.procedure]
69 NN ;; Heading.
71-73 OL [wf002.review-before-verify]
75 NN ;; Heading.
77-78 OL [wf003.verify-before-complete,gov017.report-unresolved]

C gov002.read-sources OL GOV-002,GOV-008 MUST ;; Before planning/implementing a new application or substantial feature read SPECIFICATION.md and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.inspect-apply OL WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect relevant existing code before non-trivial changes and apply the governing rules and skills. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.read-owning-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; For greenfield work or unopened files explicitly read the owning rules per area (backend code, tests, frontend, manifests, new directories/projects) before writing code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.knowledge-skills OL WF-001 MUST ;; Use knowledge skills for technique in the area being changed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.classify-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify consequential choices as Decided/Delegated/Reserved; for Reserved raise a Decision Request and continue only with independent work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.raise-concerns OL GOV-018 MUST ;; Raise material concerns about a questionable request before implementing it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-specialized OL WF-001,DEP-003,PST-008,GOV-021,ARC-027 MUST ;; Route dependency changes to add-dependency, persistence model/mapping/migration/seed changes to persistence-change, CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes to custom-settings, project/reference changes to project-structure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.regression OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; For a meaningful bug with plausible recurrence add a regression test (fails before, passes after) unless equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C run012.procedure OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance-motivated changes: identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, prefer the simplest optimization, add/preserve tests, benchmark/profile non-obvious or complex changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.review-before-verify OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial features or new applications run code-review (or the read-only agent) before final verification and fix the findings that matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.verify-before-complete OL WF-003 MUST ;; Run verify before declaring work complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.report-unresolved OL GOV-017,WF-009 MUST ;; Report unresolved Decision Requests together with the verification result. ;; = ;; none ;;
